directions.name: Painted wooden toy
directions.idea: The fortress is a set of painted wooden toy pieces on a table. Friendly, chunky, bright.
directions.palette: Warm saturated toy colours: cream stone, terracotta roofs, bright teal sea, sunny yellow sand, cherry red accents
directions.shapes: Chunky rounded blocks with fat bevels, like painted wooden toy pieces, slightly oversized cannons
directions.light: Bright noon sun, soft shadows, no haze
directions.mood: Cheerful and inviting, a toy harbour on a table
directions.type: in rounded chunky letters like carved painted wood

directions.name: Ink and parchment chart
directions.idea: The world is drawn on an old naval chart. Flat parchment tones, ink outlines, a strategist's map table.
directions.palette: Parchment cream, sepia ink outlines, dusty ochre, faded naval blue, one red wax-seal accent
directions.shapes: Angular flat forms with dark ink outlines, like pieces drawn on an old naval chart
directions.light: Flat even light, no cast shadows, soft paper grain in the sky
directions.mood: Quiet and studious, a strategist's map table
directions.type: in engraved serif capitals like an old chart title
directions.time: drawn as an old chart with a compass rose in one corner

directions.name: Lantern dusk
directions.idea: The calm before the bombardment. Cool dusk, warm lanterns, long shadows, tall silhouettes.
directions.palette: Deep blue-violet dusk, slate stone, warm orange lantern and muzzle-flash accents, a pale moon
directions.shapes: Tall slender towers and thin walls, pointed roofs, long silhouettes
directions.light: Low golden sun just set, rim light on edges, long cool shadows, lanterns glowing
directions.mood: Moody and tense, the calm before the bombardment
directions.type: in tall condensed letters with a warm glow

directions.name: Signal flag geometry
directions.idea: A board game come alive. Hard facets, bold flat primaries, team colours as loud as signal flags.
directions.palette: Bold flat primaries: navy, white, signal red, mustard yellow, with four distinct team colours deep blue, purple, teal green and olive
directions.shapes: Hard faceted geometry, no bevels, every object reduced to its simplest solid, like a board game piece
directions.light: Hard clean light, crisp shadows, no gradients
directions.mood: Bold and graphic, a board game come alive
directions.type: in heavy geometric sans-serif letters built from flag shapes

directions.name: Weathered stone and sea
directions.idea: A fort that has seen sieges. Desaturated, misty, serious, with facet colour variation instead of texture.
directions.palette: Desaturated greys, wet slate, moss green, cold teal sea, mist white, one rust accent on the cannons
directions.shapes: Heavy squat masses, chipped corners, uneven stone courses suggested by facet colour variation
directions.light: Cool overcast with soft mist, no hard shadows
directions.mood: Serious and weathered, a fort that has seen sieges
